headline: Review of potential budget requests and annual report items, plus an executive session on internal affairs case review and related votes.
summary: The meeting will cover a Northeast Civilian Oversight Forum, CPRB training, a subcommittee update, potential budget requests, and annual report items. It also includes an executive session to discuss internal affairs cases, followed by votes on the review findings.
